events.raw_narrative: Partial losses of 38 bbl/hr while drilling Kopili shale-limestone interbeds; ECD 10.9 ppg against 10.26 ppg pore pressure. Pit volume down 55 bbl over 90 min. Depth 2806.5 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Reduced flow rate from 2200 to 1800 lpm, spotted 40 bbl medium/fine CaCO3 + nut-plug LCM pill, cut mud weight 0.2 ppg
events.outcome: Losses cured after second pill; resumed drilling with reduced ROP

events.raw_narrative: Total losses at top Sylhet Limestone — returns dropped from 100% to 0% in fractured, vugular limestone. Annulus level dropped, well monitored on trip tank. Depth 2788.3 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Pumped 60 bbl cross-linked LCM pill, squeezed with 50 bbl cement plug, drilled out and continued with 10.6 ppg SBM and managed ECD
events.outcome: Returns regained after cement squeeze; 22 h NPT

events.raw_narrative: Seepage losses of 18 bbl/hr in lower Kopili while circulating bottoms-up. Depth 2842.9 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Added 15 ppb fine CaCO3 background LCM, reduced pump rate by 10%

events.raw_narrative: Erratic surface torque spikes 18-26 kNm (baseline 12 kNm) and stick-slip while drilling Barail coal stringers; string stalled twice. Depth 2461.8 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Reduced WOB 20%, increased RPM to 140, added 2% lubricant; worked pipe and back-reamed stand

events.raw_narrative: Torque spikes to 29 kNm with overpull 25 t on connection in Barail coal; cavings of blocky coal on shakers. Depth 2556.6 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Raised mud weight 0.3 ppg for coal stability, pumped hi-vis sweep, back-reamed out of hole to casing shoe
events.outcome: Hole cleaned; torque back to normal after wiper trip

events.raw_narrative: Intermittent torque spikes 16-19 kNm in abrasive Barail Sandstone; PDC bit dull grade 3-4-WT. Depth 1905.1 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Pulled for bit change to more durable PDC, optimised WOB/RPM

events.raw_narrative: 9-5/8" casing cement job: losses during displacement, top of cement 400 m below plan; CBL showed poor bond across Barail coal. Depth 2697.3 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Remedial squeeze through perforations; subsequent wells pumped lightweight lead slurry with LCM fibres and reduced displacement rate
events.outcome: Zonal isolation confirmed by second CBL

events.raw_narrative: 13-3/8" shoe track failed formation integrity test (LOT 12.1 ppg vs 13.5 ppg planned); micro-annulus suspected. Depth 1159.4 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Squeezed shoe with 30 bbl cement, re-ran FIT

events.raw_narrative: Channelling in 9-5/8" annulus due to poor centralisation in washed-out coal section. Depth 2430.9 m MD.
events.mitigation_description: Increased centraliser count; spacer volume doubled; remedial top-up job
